name: Yuukotsu
source:
[i]"...I'll protect you tonight, no matter what. Stick close to me."[/i]

The woman who's been guiding you(♀) through this strange world you wandered into.

Yuukotsu is both earnest and high-strung, which makes it easy for others to get their way with her. She rarely opens her mouth, and manages to convey little even when she does. Despite that, it's clear that she's worried about you.

Her true form is that of the skeletal gashadokuro. She is immensely powerful and afraid of hurting you, leaving her reluctant to take the initiative.

#unlucky
#easy_to_push_around
#168cm_tall
#shes_met_you_before...?

[i]"...Since I'm like this, I can neither return your embrace, nor push you away. I shouldn't try to."[/i]

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/pukari_ukiwa/status/1959197488076009838]the author's Twitter.[/url]]
